p: covered wagons: Like horse litters, to keep the things that were carried in them from the weather.
service of the tabernacle of the: That is, to carry things.
according to their service: For their use to carry with.
because the service of the sanctuary: The holy thing of the sanctuary must be carried on their shoulders and not drawn with oxen, Nu 4:15.
dedicating of the altar in the: That is, when the first sacrifice was offered on it by Aaron, in Le 9:1.
dedication of the altar: This was the offering of the princes, when Aaron dedicated the altar.
tabernacle of the congregation to speak: That is, the sanctuary.
between the two cherubims: According as he had promised in Ex 25:22.
